Text.Text: Either keep walking, or stop and make it look like we are old friends. My name is Vex Tarro. People pay me to make their problems on this moon go away, and I pay people like you to do the work.
Then I have earned my retainer. Here is your cut of it. The shops are generous when they have been frightened.
You are back, and three shopkeepers smiled at me this morning. Did you kill all twelve Troublemakers?

Troublemakers are shaking down every shopfront in the Corporate District, and the shopkeepers pay me a retainer to make it stop. I need you to kill twelve Troublemakers. You will find them here in the Corporate District and down in the Slums. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you your cut.
Good. Kill twelve Troublemakers in the Corporate District or the Slums on Smuggler's Moon, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twelve Troublemakers in the Corporate District or the Slums on Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when it is done.
Good work. The captains paid through me, and this is your share after my small handling fee.
You are back. The freight captains have stopped chaining their containers together. Did you kill all twelve Thieves?

Thieves work the Catwalks and the Shipping District, and they are good at it. One freight captain lost a whole container while he was standing on it. The captains are paying me to thin them out. I need you to kill twelve Thieves on the Catwalks or in the Shipping District, then come back to me for your pay.
Good. Kill twelve Thieves on the Catwalks or in the Shipping District on Smuggler's Moon, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twelve Thieves on the Catwalks or in the Shipping District on Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is your cut. The Red Blades will remember your face, so I would wear a hood on the Catwalks for a while.
You are back. I hear the Red Blades have cut their toll in half. Did you kill all ten of them?

A gang called the Red Blades has claimed the Catwalks and charges a toll to anyone who crosses. My clients cross the Catwalks every day, and they are tired of paying. I need you to go up onto the Catwalks and kill ten Red Blades. Come back to me afterward and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Red Blades on the Catwalks on Smuggler's Moon, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Red Blades on the Catwalks on Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when it is done.
My client is pleased, although the bookmakers are not. Here is your cut of the fee.
You are back. The Fight Club is short of fighters this week. Did you kill all ten Arena Fighters?

Between bouts, the Arena Fighters hire themselves out as muscle in the Shipping District, and they are better at it than the gangs are. One of my clients wants them stopped. I need you to kill ten Arena Fighters in the Shipping District. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Arena Fighters in the Shipping District on Smuggler's Moon, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Arena Fighters in the Shipping District on Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when it is done.
I did not know pirates apologized, but they do when the alternative is you. Here is your cut.
You are back. A stolen shipment turned up in its owner's warehouse with an apology attached. Did you kill all ten Pirates?

The stolen cargo goes down. Pirates run it through the Sewers to ships that nobody inspects, and they keep a second crew out on the abandoned station in orbit. I need you to kill ten Pirates, in the Sewers or on the station, whichever you prefer. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Pirates in the Sewers on Smuggler's Moon or on the abandoned Smuggler's Moon Station, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Pirates in the Sewers on Smuggler's Moon or on the abandoned Smuggler's Moon Station. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is the flat rate, as promised. The same work is waiting whenever you want it again.
You are back with blood on your sleeve. Did you kill ten Troublemakers and ten Thieves?

I always do. This moon makes new Troublemakers and new Thieves every day, so I pay a flat rate to keep their numbers down. Each time, I need you to kill ten Troublemakers and ten Thieves on the streets of Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when you have done both and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Troublemakers and ten Thieves on the streets of Smuggler's Moon, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Troublemakers and ten Thieves on the streets of Smuggler's Moon. Come back to me when it is done.
We never spoke, Vex.
What other problems do you need handled?
Yes, all twelve Troublemakers are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Twelve Troublemakers in the Corporate District or the Slums.
Not right now. The shops can hire their own guards.
What trouble are the shopkeepers having?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Troublemakers.
Yes, all twelve Thieves are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Twelve Thieves on the Catwalks or in the Shipping District.
Not right now. Everyone on this moon steals.
Who is stealing from the freight captains?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Thieves.
Yes, I killed ten Red Blades.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Ten Red Blades on the Catwalks.
Not right now. Gang wars are not my business.
Which gang is causing you problems?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Red Blades.
Yes, all ten Arena Fighters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Ten Arena Fighters in the Shipping District.
Not right now. I will leave the fighters alone.
Who does the fighting for the gangs?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Arena Fighters.
Yes, all ten Pirates are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Ten Pirates, in the Sewers or on the station.
Not right now. I prefer to stay above ground.
Where does all the stolen cargo go?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Pirates.
Yes, I killed ten of each.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll run a sweep. Ten Troublemakers and ten Thieves.
Not today, Vex. Maybe another time.
Do you have any regular work?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need for the street sweep.
